name: Agency Lead Times
query:
SELECT
    a.name AS "Agency:Link/Agency:150",
    a.agency_name AS "Agency Name::150",
    ai.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:150",
    ai.min_order_qty AS "Min Order Qty:Float:150",
    ai.lead_time_days AS "Lead Time:Int:120"
FROM
    `tabAgency` a
JOIN
    `tabAgency Item` ai ON ai.parent = a.name
WHERE
    a.docstatus < 2
    AND a.is_active = 1

    AND (
        %(agency)s IS NULL
        OR %(agency)s = ''
        OR a.name = %(agency)s
    )

    AND (
        %(item)s IS NULL
        OR %(item)s = ''
        OR ai.item_code = %(item)s
    )

ORDER BY
    a.name, ai.item_code
